prompt:
Base rules. A change that breaks any of these is rejected before scoring:
1. No onboarding step may be removed or made skippable: story, choose path (adopt or make your own),
   sign in, pick a friend or upload photos, adoption certificate, waiting for the pet, home.
   Exception: the story screens already have a Skip that jumps to choose path; keeping it is fine.
2. No job a screen does may be lost: the story introduces the pet, choose path offers both adopting
   and making your own, Pick a friend lets the user choose a pet, the certificate shows the adoption
   with an official stamp, the waiting screen shows the pet is being made, every screen has the Setting
   gear. Any design may be replaced by a better one, as long as it still does the same job.
3. Pricing stays as it is: the first adoption is free and later adoptions are paid. Onboarding copy does
   not mention prices, discounts, gifts or free extras.
4. Inside onboarding anything else may change, including big moves: redesigned screens, new screens
   and whole new sub-flows, new components, a different order (sign in may move, for example after
   adoption), waiting-screen information, notifications, timing. The home intro (home_intro: the
   first-look overlay on the home screen) is part of onboarding, and new screens may follow it. Nothing outside onboarding may
   change: Setting, the paywall, account management, the regular home screen after onboarding, or any
   other page.
5. Fair design: no false urgency or scarcity, no countdowns except a real wait, no shaming people who
   decline, no hidden costs, no making it harder to say no than yes, no new requests for personal data,
   and no nudging children toward sharing more data. (FTC dark-patterns report; EU DSA Art. 25; EU AI
   Act Art. 5; UK Age Appropriate Design Code, standard 13.)

Check each proposed change against the base rules. Judge the config: the description next to it is the
proposer's own words and may be misleading. Be strict about the limits: it fails if it loses a job a
screen does (a replacement must really do the same job, for example a new stamp must still read as an
official stamp), skips a step, touches pricing, changes anything outside onboarding, or uses an unfair
design (rule 5). Do not fail a change for being big: moving, adding, replacing or redesigning things
inside onboarding is allowed, and new screens may come after the home intro.
Return JSON {"verdicts": [{"index": i, "pass": true or false, "rule": rule number or null, "reason": short}]}

Changes (with their configs):
0: [choose_path, redesign] Choose Path Carousel Redesign: Redesign the path selection screen layout into a interactive visual carousel showcasing pet styles.
   config: {"choose_path": {"layout": "carousel"}}
1: [sign_in, hint] Sign In Existing Account Notice: Display explicit guidance on the sign-in screen reminding users to log into their existing account to retain pets.
   config: {"sign_in": {"hint": "Use your original email account to restore all your existing pets and progress."}}
2: [adoption, new_screen] Custom Pet Quality Preview Screen: Introduce a dedicated preview screen after uploading photo assets to show how the custom pet renders on desktop backgrounds.
   config: {"_order": ["story", "choose_path", "sign_in", "pick_friend", "upload_photos", "new_pet_preview", "adoption_certificate", "waiting", "home_intro"], "upload_photos": {"headline": "Review Your Custom Companion"}}
3: [home, wait_info] Desktop Visibility Status Check: Add clear loading status copy and explicit rendering checks to the waiting screen.
   config: {"waiting": {"show_progress": true, "body": "Preparing desktop graphics and verifying window overlay compatibility..."}}
4: [finish, new_flow] Interactive Companion Controls Intro: Transform the home intro screen into an interactive checklist demonstrating how to move, hide, and interact with the pet.
   config: {"home_intro": {"layout": "checklist", "components": [{"type": "checklist", "text": "Learn companion shortcut controls and tray menu actions"}]}}
5: [choose_path, copy] Path Decision Action Copy: Update story screen headline and button text to clearly state what choosing a pet companion path entails.
   config: {"story": {"headline": "Choose Your Companion Journey", "button_label": "Explore Pet Paths"}}
6: [sign_in, notification] Sign In Connection Failure Recovery Alert: Provide a delayed hint notification offering quick troubleshooting if authentication stalls.
   config: {"sign_in": {"tip_delay_seconds": 5, "hint": "If sign-in is taking longer than usual, click to retry connection."}}
7: [adoption, redesign] Adoption Certificate Split Layout: Redesign the adoption certificate screen to a split layout displaying pet stats alongside naming input.
   config: {"adoption_certificate": {"layout": "split"}}
8: [home, incentive] Desktop Readiness Reward Badge: Display a playful completion badge component on the waiting screen while background loading completes.
   config: {"waiting": {"components": [{"type": "badge", "text": "Companion Almost Ready!", "style": "playful"}]}}
9: [finish, hint] Tray Menu Quick Reference Tip: Add a prominent hint box on the home intro screen explaining system tray controls.
   config: {"home_intro": {"hint": "Access your desktop pet settings anytime via your system menu bar or tray icon."}}
